articles.summary: StockStory: 1 Large-Cap Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 That Underwhelm. Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players. Related tickers mentioned: KEYS, QCOM.
